341:t_10:46.en:
$$クロウ$$
「I'm counting on you for that. Visiting a grave empty-handed just wouldn't look right.」

341:t_10:47.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Do you have an acquaintance buried here on Mars?」

341:t_10:48.en:
$$クロウ$$
「...Once someone's dead, enemy or ally, old grudges don't matter anymore. The least I can do is lay some flowers.」

341:t_10:49.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Then I'll come pick it up later. I'm counting on you, AG.」

341:t_10:50.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That's a stylish touch, $$クロウ・ブルースト$$...」

341:t_10:52.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「His strong will ought to be a good influence on $n as well.」

341:t_10:54.en:
$$スズネ$$
「The problem is what comes next.」

341:t_10:56.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Everything has started moving... toward the true collapse that comes once every 120 million years...」

341:t_10:57.en:
$$スズネ$$
「The moment we return to Earth is the beginning of the end, then...」

341:t_10:59.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Until then, keep putting your heart into your business.」

341:t_10:60.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Of course! Then let's give it our all again today... business, business!」

342:t_000:1.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Um... checking the navigation system... What does the position sensor say...」

342:t_001:0.en:
$$ドロシー#bigo$$
「All around us, 360 degrees, a sea of stars...」

342:t_001:1.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Now then, where should we start...」

342:t_001:2.en:
$$デュオ$$
「We charged out all fired up, but it's not like we have anything to go on.」

342:t_001:3.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Securing our safety comes first. We'll start by checking our surroundings.」

342:t_001:6.en:
$$カレン$$
「Oh... no, it's nothing...! It's nothing, really!」

342:t_001:7.en:
$n
「The basic rule of survival is to never overlook small changes. Tell me even the most trivial thing, $$カレン$$.」

342:t_001:8.en:
$$カレン$$
「I-I'm fine! It's nothing! Really, it's nothing!」

342:t_001:9.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「Whether it's safe or useful, we'll judge together.」

342:t_001:12.en:
$$カレン$$
「I just thought... this place is beautiful...」

342:t_001:15.en:
$$カレン$$
「I-I know this isn't the time to be saying things like that either...!」

342:t_001:16.en:
$$ヒルデ$$
「But I feel the same way as $$カレン$$.」

342:t_001:17.en:
$$モーム$$
「Yeah...! It's all sparkly and so lovely!」

342:t_001:18.en:
$$桂$$
「True enough... Even I, who am used to seeing the multiverse, think so.」

342:t_001:19.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Now that's a view worth 1 million G.」

342:t_001:22.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Everyone... I'm sorry to interrupt while you're captivated by this enchanting sight, but we have an emergency.」

342:t_002:0.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I've confirmed a distortion in the dimensional boundary. Something is teleporting into this space.」

342:t_003:0.en:
$$スズネ$$
「$$宇宙怪獣$$ and Invaders! There are $$バジュラ$$ too!」

342:t_003:1.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Those monsters that look like spiral shells are believed to be the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$ from $$チェインバー#pilot$$'s data!」

342:t_003:2.en:
$$五飛$$
「The enemies of humanity have gathered.」

342:t_003:3.en:
$$トロワ$$
「There's no sign of coordination between the factions, but no sign of hostility among them either.」

342:t_003:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The galactic center is, so to speak, the sphere of influence of $$バアル$$. They most likely intend to eliminate us for entering their own territory.」

342:t_003:6.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「It's pointless to demand reason from them! We have no choice but to fight!」

342:t_003:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「E-everyone! Considering what lies ahead, it would be extremely bad for this ship to take damage!」

342:t_003:8.en:
$n
「I know, AG! Hold the ship in that position and concentrate on defense!」

342:t_004:2.en:
$$宗介$$
「When we transferred into this space, your $$血塗られた眼$$ had appeared.」

342:t_004:4.en:
$$スズネ$$
「It's nothing serious. I'm having them join the battle as is.」

342:t_004:6.en:
$$スズネ$$
「We're doing this, $n. Wherever we are, we have to carve out our own path by our own strength...!」

342:t_005:0.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「All units, begin the attack! Fight with everything you have to survive!」

342:t_006:0.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Be careful! Something is coming into this area!」

342:t_006:2.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「No... this time it's an approach under normal navigation.」

342:t_007:0.en:
$$宗介$$
「The $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$!?」

342:t_007:1.en:
$$マオ$$
「$$テッサ$$...! Is $$テッサ$$ there!?」

342:t_007:2.en:
$$テッサ$$
「$$メリッサ$$...! And everyone else too!」

342:t_007:3.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「Being attacked by the $$サイデリアル$$ in the Pacific and then thrown into some unknown region of space was surprising enough, but to think they would be here as well...」

342:t_007:4.en:
$$テッサ$$
「I can only think that some kind of design is at work here.」

342:t_007:6.en:
$$クロウ$$
「The word that bastard 《$$アイム#keyword$$》 used, huh.」

342:t_007:7.en:
$$桂$$
「Those who bear it are tossed about by the $$時空震動$$ as cursed wanderers...」

342:t_007:8.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Those of us gathered here may have been sent by that $$烙印$$.」

342:t_007:9.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Thinking can wait. First, let's get through this situation!」

342:t_007:11.en:
$$テッサ$$
($$相良$$ chose $$カナメ$$... And now $$カナメ$$ has fallen into the hands of $$アマルガム$$, and we're somewhere unknown...)

342:t_007:12.en:
$$テッサ$$
($$相良$$ is still fighting, though... I'm sure with a vow in his heart to take $$カナメ$$ back...)
